serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Here, 100$. I really have to go right now, bye.
Hobo: Wait, wait, wait…{{wi}} With today’s inflation this is nothing! How am I to survive with this?!
You: W-what do you mean, you can just get the bread from the dispenser. Besides, I'm broke too!
Hobo: No, I don’t think so! You are too clean to be truly broke! Come on man, don’t be heartless!
You: Listen, it’s not my fault you are like that, just leave me alone!
Hobo: Alright, sorry, I went a little overboard…{{wi}} How about a hug to make up?
You: N-no! Back off!
Ugh! I don’t wanna touch this dirty fucker! Who knows what kind of diseases he is spreading!
#Hobo.Face.smile
